message: Deployment complete. Writer wait now measures full-channel waits and is displayed in milliseconds per second.

markers.label: Socket telemetry deployment
markers.details: Collector restarted with per-socket telemetry. Books and subscriptions rebuilt after restart.

markers.label: Stream mode enabled
markers.details: Collector restarted to stream SBE over WebSocket. File output stopped. Subscriber-dependent encoding was corrected in the later deployment.

markers.label: Continuous SBE encoding restored
markers.details: Collector restarted to encode every output record, even without subscribers. Encoding latency and output counters no longer depend on connected clients.

markers.label: Writer wait measurement corrected
markers.details: Collector restarted to count wait only after the output channel reports full. Earlier samples may include ordinary send overhead. The chart now displays milliseconds waiting per second.
